concepts.name: The Meaning Of Federalism Federalism Is
concepts.simple_definition: The meaning of federalism Federalism is a system of government where power is divided between federal and regional governments
concepts.deep_explanation: Devolution, the principle of federalism means to transfer power of the region that constitutes the federation
concepts.real_example: Practical example of The meaning of federalism Federalism is  from page 110.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse The meaning of federalism Federalism is  with adjacent topics in Chapter 5.
concepts.name_amharic: The meaning of federalism Federalism is  (በአማርኛ)
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: [አማርኛ] The meaning of federalism Federalism is a system of government where power is divided between federal and regional governments (ይህ ትርጓሜ በኢትዮጵያ የ10ኛ ክፍል ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የተዘጋጀ ነው)።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] Devolution, the principle of federalism means to transfer power of the region that constitutes the federation — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: [አማርኛ] በገጽ 110 ላይ ያለውን ተግባራዊ ምሳሌ ይመልከቱ።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: [አማርኛ] ተማሪዎች ይህንን ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ከሌሎች ተዛማጅ ርዕሶች ጋር ሊያደናግሩ ይችላሉ።

concepts.name: Each Has Sovereign Powers Derived From T
concepts.simple_definition: each has sovereign powers derived from the constitution rather than another level government, each is empowered to deal directly with its citizens in the exercise of its legislative, executive and taxing powers and each is directly elected by its citizens’
concepts.deep_explanation: ‘Federalism is an institutional arrangement in which (a) public authority is divided between state governments and a central government, (b) each level of government has some issues on which it makes final decisions, and (c) a high federal court adjudicates disputes concerning federalism’

concepts.name: Types Of Federalism Federal Systems Are
concepts.simple_definition: Types of federalism Federal systems are usually known for dividing power between the federal government and the states
concepts.deep_explanation: However, laws that are made by the states (regions) usually apply to the respective regions where as laws by federal legislatures apply to all states
